text: The finding (Hassabis and colleagues) that patients with hippocampal amnesia are also impaired at imagining novel future or fictional scenarios is used to support which claim?
choices: Episodic memory is simply the retrieval of a discrete stored engram
Semantic and episodic memory form a single undifferentiated system
Memory is a storehouse whose contents imagination cannot share
Episodic memory and future imagination draw on a common constructive system
explanation: The memory-imagination overlap indicates that remembering and imagining share a common constructive (simulation) system, the view developed by Michaelian and Schacter. This tells against the archival/trace picture of memory as retrieval of a discrete engram; it neither collapses the semantic-episodic distinction nor states the separate causal-theory requirement.
